Yanhe () is a Chinese Vocaloid developed formerly by Bplats, Inc. under the Yamaha Corporation, and was created in collaboration with Shanghai Henian Information Technology Co. Ltd. She was released for the Vocaloid 3 and Vocaloid 5 engines. Her voice is provided by a female Chinese voice actress Seira Ryū. It was announced on the 9th Chinese International Cartoon and Game Expo (CCG) on July 11, 2013.
